teaser.en: In hungry times, this plant's bitter tuber can be washed and washed until it yields a clean white starch.
teaser.sw: Nyakati za njaa, kiazi kichungu cha mmea huu kinaweza kuoshwa na kuoshwa tena hadi kitoe wanga safi mweupe.

summary.en: *Ulanga* is Polynesian arrowroot, a herb of sandy coastal bushland with a starchy round tuber. Once the bitterness is washed out, the tuber yields starch and has served as a famine food.
summary.sw: *Ulanga* ni mmea mdogo wa vichaka vya pwani vyenye mchanga, wenye kiazi cha mviringo chenye wanga (kwa Kiingereza *Polynesian arrowroot*). Uchungu ukishaoshwa, kiazi hutoa wanga na kimewahi kutumika kama chakula cha wakati wa njaa.

about.en:
*Ulanga* grows from a round underground tuber. Each season it sends up one large leaf, deeply cut into many lobes, on a tall stalk.

The flowers are unusual: they grow in an umbrella-shaped cluster at the top of a separate stalk, with long, thread-like bracts trailing down from them like whiskers. The plant dies back in the dry season.
about.sw:
*Ulanga* huota kutoka kiazi cha mviringo kilicho chini ya ardhi. Kila msimu hutoa jani moja kubwa, lililokatika kwa kina kuwa sehemu nyingi, juu ya kikonyo kirefu.

Maua yake ni ya ajabu: hukua katika kishada chenye umbo la mwavuli juu ya kikonyo kingine, na vikaratasi virefu kama nyuzi vikining'inia kutoka kwake kama sharubu. Mmea hunyauka wakati wa kiangazi.

where.en: Look for *ulanga* in coastal bushland on sandy soils. It is easiest to see in the rains, when the single big leaf and the whiskered flower head appear.
where.sw: Mtafute *ulanga* katika vichaka vya pwani kwenye udongo wa mchanga. Ni rahisi zaidi kuuona wakati wa mvua, jani lake moja kubwa na kishada cha maua chenye sharubu vinapotokea.

uses.en: The tuber is bitter when raw and cannot be eaten as it is. Once the bitterness has been washed out, it yields a fine starch, and in times of hunger *ulanga* has been used as a famine food.
uses.sw: Kiazi ni kichungu kikiwa kibichi na hakiwezi kuliwa hivyo hivyo. Uchungu ukishaoshwa, hutoa wanga laini, na nyakati za njaa *ulanga* umewahi kutumika kama chakula cha wakati wa njaa.

culture.en: One of its names, *muhi wa nyoka*, means 'snake plant'.
culture.sw: Mojawapo ya majina yake, *muhi wa nyoka*, linamaanisha 'mmea wa nyoka'.

names.en: Digo: *ulanga*, also *muhi wa nyoka*, 'snake plant'. Swahili: *ulanga*. English: Polynesian arrowroot. Scientists call it *Tacca leontopetaloides*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *ulanga*, pia *muhi wa nyoka*, 'mmea wa nyoka'. Kiswahili: *ulanga*. Kwa Kiingereza: *Polynesian arrowroot*. Wanasayansi huuita *Tacca leontopetaloides*.

reason.en: Bitter yam, another tuber that needs careful preparation
reason.sw: Kiazi kikuu kichungu, kiazi kingine kinachohitaji kutayarishwa kwa uangalifu
Mhogo, kiazi cha wanga cha kila siku
Msapo, chakula kingine cha wakati wa njaa
